children: ADVANCED OXYGEN TECHNOLOGIES INC reported full-year 2026 results with revenue of $47444 and net income attributable to common stockholders of $102970 driven by higher lease income and improved operating cash flow versus the prior year.
Revenue was $47444, compared with $43445 in the prior year; YoY change 9.2%.
Net income was $102970, compared with $4138 in the prior year; YoY change 2389%.
Diluted EPS was $0.03, compared with $0 in the prior year.
Revenue growth to $47,444 in FY2026 was primarily driven by increased lease income.
Lease revenue from subsidiary ANV became the company's primary operating revenue source, surpassing commission activity.
Sharx continued to generate commission revenue through non-exclusive drop-ship distribution, maintaining product channel presence.
Lease accounting was updated under ASC 842 with straight-line recognition and $3,189 of contract liabilities recorded at year-end.
Operating cash flow improved to $51,378 in FY2026, reflecting stronger recurring rental collections.
